reviews.text: Rip off. We had 2 tours booked through this platform as it seemed convenient to have this all in one place. However, the first tour, a private boat tour of Capri was cancelled <24 hours in advance quoting poor weather/water conditions. We booked a separate tour (shared as it was too last minute for a private booking) and the weather conditions were not only perfect, they were never predicted to be bad nor had any other company cancelled their tours. We suspect we were cancelled due to being a 2 person private party on a tour that provides food and drink when a larger party would be more desirable but I can’t prove that. Now, I receive a WhatsApp message at 11 pm the night before a 9 am tour of tangier leaving from Morocco, and they want an additional $50 because the pick up location of our hotel is outside the city center. The address for pickup was provided at the time of booking over a month ago. The company claims they were unable to reach me via WhatsApp, but they only tried recently and did not try via the get your guide messages until I reached out to them to get information. This seems like a last minute scam to get more mi et when they know we are committed to this tour in just a little over 9 hours. I will not be booking through get your guide again.

reviews.text:
Double standards on cancellations - Rigid policy for customers zero accountability for themselves.. I am deeply disappointed with Get Your Guide's customer service and their complete lack of flexibility. I had to cancel a booking for the "Estes Park: Rocky Mountain National Park Glass-Top Bus Tour" due to a genuine misunderstanding regarding the activity details. Because the request fell outside their strict 24-hour cancellation window, customer care completely shut down the request.

I wasn't even asking for a cash refund back to my card- i explicitly requested simple app or website credit to use on a future booking since the booking itself was made right near the cutoff line. Despite my standing as a returning customer who has used their platform internationally, support agents (Jhomari, Jerlene, and Ma.) simply repeated the exact same rigid policy text I could have read myself on the app. "Customer care" in this scenario was entirely useless.

What makes this absolutely ridiculous is the blatant double standard. In September 2024, I booked a Colosseum and Roman Forum tour for my family in Rome through GetYourGuide (Booking GYG48ZRGB6FA). The tour operator called and unilaterally canceled our booking on the very day of the tour, completely disrupting our limited time in a foreign country and forcing us to scramble to replan our entire day.

When Get Your Guide or their partners fail to plan correctly, customers are expected to just accept it. But when a loyal customer requests basic flexibility and an internal credit 16 hours ahead of time, GetYourGuide hides behind "fairness and consistency". Their policies do not ensure fairness, they ensure the company is protected while the customer takes 100% of the risk.

I will be escalating this through alternate channels. Take your business elsewhere if you expect a company that values loyalty or offers mutual flexibility.

reviews.text:
Wonderful Central Mongolia tour. I booked this Best 5-Days Central Mongolian Tour by CentralMongoliaTour.com on GYG. It was all that it was billed as, and more. The tour is a perfect sampler of Mongolia for those who have a week in the country. The tour is a comfortable but non-stop blend of rich and intricate history, long-standing culture, invigorating outdoor activities, and exposure to the incredible landscape, scenery, and interdependency of animal species with each others and with their human caretakers. It also leaves a day or two to comfortably explore Ulaanbaatar and take a day trip to Tereji Park. Mongolia is a special place on earth and its people are rooted in its nomadic and Buddhist lifestyle. While I, as a solo traveler, booked this as an advertised group tour, I found out to my surprise, and eventual benefit, that I was the only tourist. This gave me special opportunity to interact with my wonderful, personable, and knowledgeable guide, Sanchi, and the driver, Angarag, who seemed to enjoy negotiating the challenges of the imperfectly paved highways and off-road, dirt paths of the countryside. The drive itself was an E-ride adventure and worthy of its own mention as a highlight weaving between herds of sheep, goats, horses, cows, and yaks. The drive is not for those inclined to motion sickness or with weak backs. The time in herders’ homes is interesting but not for those who are dependent on the comforts of modern living, such as internet connection and hard plumbing. The remoteness of the areas for horse and camel riding, also afforded me the serenity of hearing birds chirping a hundred yards away, seeing the stars fill the black sky at night and a brilliant rainbow during the day. Sanchi provided important insight as a native. She especially made my private tour less of a formal lesson in Mongolia and more like a new friend enthusiastically showing off her home. She cares a lot about her job and tries to give her clients the best experience. Ask for Sanchi and Angarag, if possible.
￼
